The '''Qonto system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located near the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]], within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was connected by the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Xerton system/Legends|Xerton]] and [[Sartinaynian system|Bastion]] systems,<ref name="TEA" /> and it was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Qonto]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="RM" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Qonto system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-3.<ref name="TEA" />
